title: Marguerite and the Harvest
author: Coral Zhou
blurb: Rafael Villalobos, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
